Persistent Systems to acquire German firm Nagarro for $1.3 billion

Persistent Systems has announced its intention to acquire the German digital engineering company Nagarro for approximately $1.3 billion (€1 billion). The deal, approved by Persistent's board, is described as the company's largest acquisition to date. If completed, the acquisition is expected to significantly alter India's IT sector rankings, moving Persistent Systems to the seventh position.
